div.div:
router.py (/api, CurrentUser, own rows only; another person's id is 404)
GET /notifications (?cursor, ?unread)
GET /notifications/unread-count
POST /notifications/seen, /read-all
POST /notifications/{id}/read, /{id}/unread
GET / PUT /notifications/preferences
PUT / DELETE /notifications/mutes
limits: rate_read 300/60, rate_write 60/60 per account

div.div:
handlers.py @subscribe
deeds: DeedVerified (recognised, deed_verified for invites, starts the network fan-out)
feed: DeedLiked, CommentPosted (comment + capped reply), UserFollowed, CommentModerationDecided
media: PhotoModerationDecided, PhotoRemovedByDoer, AvatarModerationDecided
scoring: BadgeAwarded, HeroTitleAwarded, AwardWithdrawn (marks the award row withdrawn, sends nothing)
identity: PasswordChanged
fraud: MemberReviewUpdate, ReviewsSeen only (D112)

Network rows hold no deed id (SEC6-L1)

div.div: Rules (M6-DESIGN D104, D106, D112; test_architecture.py). Nobody imports notifications. It may import app.core, deeds.service and identity.service, and from feed, media, scoring and fraud only the named event classes and the three feed reads. Rows hold ids, codes and numbers only; text is rendered on read. Members never see fraud wording, case data or other subjects (D101). Email and push are M6B (not built).
